title: Constructibility is local on a finite covering by retrocompact opens
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a subset is constructible exactly when its traces on a finite covering by retrocompact opens are constructible there (author lemma at source lines 2851-2858, label lemma-collate-constructible). The proof (source lines 2860-2870) uses the pullback statements for open and for quasi-compact open immersions in the two directions and concludes by a finite union (proof lines 2860-2869). The two applications of the pullback statements are the substance. H3.
